'''''Coronet Gossip''''' was a sensationalist [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] newspaper published in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:P18" />

==Known publications==
===I was attacked by a 50 meter spider!!===
"'''''I was attacked by a 50 meter spider!!'''''" was an article published on the front page of ''Coronet Gossip''<ref name="SWG:P18" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> The article investigated the discovery of mutations in common animal species,<ref name="SWG:P18" /> giving rise to bigger, larger and more aggressive creatures.<ref name="SWG:TTE">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> The article focused particularly on [[Bane Back spider]], a mutated variant<ref name="SWG:P18" /> of [[gaping spider]].<ref name="SWG:TTE" />

The article contained the interview of an individual named [[Geeot Nuetia]] who claimed that he was attacked by a 50-meter tall spider during a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] trip to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Nuetia pretended that he killed the beast with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. Later, a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] of ''Coronet Gossip'' went to Dathomir to investigate the creature. A [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] of the [[Spiderclan/Legends|Spiderclan]] confirmed the recent emergence of the Bane Back spiders but the reporter could only found 2-3 meters tall spiders.<ref name="SWG:P18" />

{{ExcerptIU
|''"It was 50 meters tall! It had fangs growing out of it's back! Its back ridges were razor sharp! I only survived because of my lucky thermal detonator!" screams Geeot Nuetia of Coronet City after returning from a hunting trip to Dathomir. Our roving reporter went to Dathomir to learn more.''

''"The Bane Back Spider is a gift to the Spider Clan," says a woman identified only as a Web Dancer,"Its viciousness is a match for our own."''

''Despite diligent searching, the only pieces that we found were comparable to a spider that is merely 2-3 meters tall.''

''Imperial scientists have been unavailable for comment, but reports of mutations of other common species have been surfacing on Talus as well.''
|attrib=''I WAS ATTACKED BY A 50 METER SPIDER!!'', from the ''Coronet Gossip''<ref name="SWG:P18" />
}}

==Behind the scenes==
''Corellia Gossip'' appeared the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P18" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The article of ''Corellia Gossip'' "''I was attacked by a 50 meter spider!!''" appeared on a loading screen that was shown to players after the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 18 Notes for 15 Jun 2005|Publish 18]],"<ref name="SWG:P18" /> on [[June 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 18.0">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=archive%202005#june|text=Publish 18.0}}</ref> The loading screen was styled as a in-universe newspaper article and introduced the three new creatures ([[kahmurra blanca]], [[Bane Back spider]] and [[painted spat]]) added to the game with the Publish 18.<ref name="SWG:P18" /> Killing such creatures rewarded the players with a hunting trophy as decoration for their [[:w:c:swg:Housing|virtual homes]].<ref name="SWG:TTE" />
